name: Nicodemus
summary: A Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews who visited Jesus at night to talk with Him. Later he spoke up for Jesus among the Pharisees and helped lay His body in the tomb.

key_moments.title: Visits Jesus by Night
key_moments.description: Nicodemus visited Jesus at night and called Him a teacher who had come from God. Jesus told him that unless a person is born again, he cannot see God's kingdom, and Nicodemus asked how such things could be.

key_moments.title: Asking for a Fair Hearing
key_moments.description: When the Pharisees scorned Jesus, Nicodemus, who was one of them, asked whether their law judged a man before hearing him. They answered by asking if he was from Galilee too.

key_moments.title: Burying Jesus
key_moments.description: Nicodemus came with Joseph of Arimathea, bringing about a hundred pounds of myrrh and aloes. They wrapped Jesus' body in linen with the spices and laid it in a new tomb in a garden.
